content_html:
Watched #GunturKaaram : Let me make you clear this is Not #Agnyaathavaasi but not a Good Film either as Mahesh Babu is the only saving grace of this movie, who makes it a Decent Watch

Mahesh Babu finally tried to deliver something which fans wanted from him for so many years….a proper commercial movie with NO SOCIAL MESSAGE 🙏 and he succeeded in that with terrific Mass Look and Dialogue delivery but the only thing faltered is by believing in Trivikram to deliver Commercial Movie to him 😞

Kudos to Mahesh for giving his best to Dance and that too having dancer like Sree Leela against him is a huge challenge to his dancing capabilities….However he gave his best and unlike his previous attempts to dance this time he succeeded rather than making a Joke of himself

Trivikram should stop cooking stories around Family Conflicts to deliver Commercial potboilers…..there is no Juice left in this genre and he had to fill the story with unnecessary scenes to make a full fledged movie!!! Though there are couple of dialogues here and there but none of them could justify the GURUJI tag given to him 😞 and also there is no scene which could justify his masterclass!! Its high time Trivikram ditches the Family genre and move towards some other interesting concepts and also he should focus solely on his scripts and work rather than poking into scripts of PK thus creating a mess over there and here

Unlike their previous movies Athadu & Khaleja…which didn’t had good theatrical run but eventually achieved cult status….the duo of Mahesh & Trivikram wanted their third movie to be an instant commercial success and in process of trying to achieve that they forgot what the general audiences expected from their combination 🙄

Thaman should take a break…..none of the songs are upto the standards of a big hero movie!!! Tough BGM was good for action episodes but at-least for me it sounded out of place/sync for a Mother-Child Sentiment movie and would have been more apt for a Thriller

I think Guruji hired Sree Leela for a Dance number and for reasons known to him only extended her Dance Performances to multiple scenes across the movie this making her main heroine 🙏 …. its High Time for Sree Leela to start acting apart from Dancing Dancing & Dancing and trying to look/act cute in between Dances

Overall Guntur Kaaram with same subject and taking might have got bit better reviews and appreciation from audience if it had not been directed by Trivikram…..
